Publication of Circular, notice of General Meeting and 2025 Annual Report and Accounts
, a producer and exporter of premium iron ore products, is pleased to announce that it has published the following documents:
·    the Annual Report and Accounts for the year ended 31 December 2025 (the "2025 Annual Report");

·    following the announcement issued earlier today in connection with the results of the Fundraise, a circular, including the Notice of General Meeting issued and mailed to Shareholders in connection with the Fundraise (the "Circular"); and

The Circular, including the Notice of General Meeting, Form of Proxy and 2025 Annual Report are available to view on the Group's website at www.ferrexpo.com. The 2025 Annual Report will be mailed to shareholders on or around 10 September 2026.

In accordance with 6.4.1 and 6.4.3 of the UK Listing Rules and 6.3.5 of the Disclosure and Transparency Rules, a copy of the Circular, Form of Proxy, and 2025 Annual Report have been uploaded to the National Storage Mechanism and will shortly be available in unedited full text (and in the case of the 2025 Annual Report, structured electronic format) at https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism
The General Meeting will be held at the ofﬁces of Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer LLP, Exchange House, Primrose Street, London, EC2A 2EG, England at 11.00 a.m. on 21 September 2026.

Unless otherwise indicated, capitalised terms in this Announcement have the meaning given to them in Appendix E of the Company's announcement of 3 September 2026 titled "Proposed equity fundraise to raise US$100 million".

Ferrexpo is a Swiss headquartered iron ore company with assets in Ukraine and a listing in the equity shares commercial companies category on the London Stock Exchange (ticker FXPO). The Group produces premium grade iron ore products sold to the global steel industry and enabling steel makers to reduce carbon emissions and increase productivity. Ferrexpo's operations have been supplying the global steel industry for over 50 years with a customer base comprising of premium steel mills around the world. For further information, please visit www.ferrexpo.com.
